title: "The Solstice" in Inlet Beach, 30A | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "The Solstice" in Inlet Beach, 30A | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: The Solstice | Private Pool • Golf Cart • Elevator • Luxury Inlet Beach Retreat Escape to The Solstice, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath luxury retreat in the Grande Pointe community of Inlet Beach. Thoughtfully designed with upscale finishes, designer furnishings, and premium amenities, this is where effortless beach days meet elevated coastal living. Why You'll Love It: Private pool* (optional heating available for $35/day) ️ Complimentary six-seater electric golf cart** Six adult beach cruisers Elevator to all floors ️ Less than 1 mile to Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access EV-friendly 240V charging outlet in the garage ‍ Gourmet kitchen with luxury appliances ☀️ Multiple balconies for morning coffee & evening cocktails Community pool and dock overlooking beautiful Lake Powell ⚡ Fast Wi-Fi & Smart TVs throughout An Unbeatable Location Nestled in Grande Pointe, you'll enjoy easy access to some of the Emerald Coast's most beloved destinations: Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access (less than a mile) Camp Helen State Park & scenic nature trails (less than a mile) ️ 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach (one mile) ️ Pier Park shopping & entertainment (15-min drive) ✈️ ECP Airport (25-min drive) 1st Floor: Double garage with beach storage closet + EV charging capability Private, optionally-heated* pool Bedroom 1: King bedroom with hallway bathroom (shower/tub combo) and access to back yard/pool 2nd Floor: Open concept kitchen, dining, and living area with large flat-screen TV Office nook with desk and chair Gourmet kitchen with plentiful counter space and top-of-the line appliances Dining table seating for six with an additional three seats at the large kitchen island Laundry room with full-size washer and dryer Powder room 3rd Floor: Bedroom 2: Primary owner suite: King bed + private bathroom (walk-in roman shower, double vanity) and private balcony Bedroom 3: Queen bed (shared balcony) Bedroom 4: Queen bed (shared balcony) Hallway bathroom (walk-in shower) Other Amenities: Outdoor shower ⛱ Beach gear (chairs, umbrella, beach towels, wagon, beach games) ☕️ Coffee makers: Keurig + standard drip Board games Travel crib Kid’s dinnerware High chair To enhance your stay, we also provide a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest essentials, including: Body Wash, Shampoo & Conditioner Hand Soap, Dish Soap & Dishwasher Pods Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Facial Tissues ️ Trash Bags & Dish Sponge Laundry Detergent Guest Support: Need assistance? Coast’s dedicated management team is available to help with anything you need—just give us a call! Important Notes: Age Requirement: The primary guest must be 25 or older to book. Parking: The home comes with driveway parking for two cars. Check-In Policy: Please do not arrive before your scheduled check-in time. No Pets & No Smoking: This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of rental fees, with the guest responsible for any damages. The home is also strictly non-smoking. *Pool heating can be added to your booking for an additional fee of $35/night. Please contact our team prior to your stay to have this arranged. **The golf cart is included as a complimentary amenity for your enjoyment. While we inspect it regularly and do our best to keep it in working order, occasional issues can occur. For this reason, refunds or discounts are not provided if a golf cart is unavailable during your stay.

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
